text:
maya: Quick thread  HW + SI bundle private-offer for Orion Appliances. Request from partner: single SKU listing in marketplace that includes a 2-month deployment credit and a tiered commit discount. Need to agree guardrails so we don't take open-ended risk.

riley: Single SKU is cleaner for customers but tricky for our accounting. Ops: can we map deployment credit as `promo_deploy` metadata so Console/Optimize can filter it out of unit economics?

zhao: Yes, we can. Prefer billing adjustment events instead of SKU changes: less runway in serving code. We'll add `credit_tag:promo_deploy` and `partner:orion`.

olga: From partner ops: SI wants the deployment credit to be refundable if customer cancels within 30 days. That feels risky. Recommend a pro-rata clawback clause.

maya: Agree on pro-rata clawback. Also propose a hard cap: deployment credit max $30k per customer. Keeps exposure bounded.

riley: For commit discount tiers propose: 0-100k = 0%, 100k-500k = 10%, 500k+ = 18%. Early renewal kicker: additional 5% if they renew into equal-or-higher tier within 45 days of term end.

zhao: Implementation note: tag renewal credits as `credit_type:early_renew` and include `cap_usd` field in billing event. Example event: `{\"event_type\":\"credit_adjust\",\"cust\":\"C999\",\"offer\":\"ORION-PVT-2026\",\"tag\":\"promo_deploy\",\"amount_usd\":15000,\"cap_usd\":30000}`. (billing team will format schema as needed)

olga: Sales concern: if listing shows big deployment credits, field will push customers to sign before SI can schedule delivery. Suggest delayed listing live date until SI schedule confirmed (2 weeks).

maya: Sounds good. Also, legal wants a one-sentence anti-gaming clause: "Credits are contingent on bona fide usage and delivery; misuse will void credits." Should suffice.

finance-bot: FYI: credits recorded as contra-revenue; early-renew credits to be treated as deferred rebates per ASC guidance. Finance to review amount caps before publish.

riley: Action items: (1) Zhao: billing event PR + `cap_usd` flag (2) Olga: confirm SI refund/clawback language (3) Maya: draft marketplace copy with a short phrase: "Includes deployment credit up to $30k and tiered committed discounts" (4) Finance: confirm classification and cap.

zhao: Will open PR and include `applied_automatically: true|false` flag for marketplaces that require manual voucher issuance.

olga: I'll get SI timelines and add a recommended go-live window to the collateral.

maya: If we agree on caps and clawback, we can lock the private-offer by COB. Anyone object?

riley: No objections. :thumbsup:

finance-bot: Noted. Finance will respond with final guidance within 6 hours.

maya: Thanks team. I'll schedule a follow-up to approve listing date once SI returns availability.

announce-bot: Thread archived to #partnerships  thread 4132109876.
